title: manufacturing.serving_table input
description: One product information sheet's amounts: its batch/lot, the certificate's figures, the packages made from it and, for a package's own sheet, that package.

source.description: The batch/lot record (or, for a package of an untracked maker, that package's record); only analyteWeight is read: an analyteWeight present but not a JSON number means no amounts at all (DOSE-20).

meta.description: The certificate's figures (psilocybin, psilocin, lab_tpe, psilocybin_from and the four alkaloids, mg/g), or null; its TPE is coa.tpe's rule.

made.description: The packages made from it (productGuid, description, weightPerUnit and analyteWeight are read).

package.description: The package whose own sheet this is (its one-column table), or null.
